title: Partial losses in Tipam sands
problem: Losses of 6-30 m3/h in unconsolidated Tipam sand when ECD exceeds the fracture window.
cause: High permeability sand, ECD above the pore pressure window.
mitigation: Reduce flow rate, pump a 30 bbl LCM pill (fine + medium), keep ECD below 1.30 SG.
outcome: Losses cured in 8 h on average.

title: Total losses in Namsang conglomerate
problem: No returns when drilling conglomerate stringers.
mitigation: Spot a cement plug, drill ahead with reduced MW and a blind drilling procedure.

title: Mechanical sticking in Barail shale
problem: Tight hole and overpull on trips through Barail coal and shale.
mitigation: Limit trip speed, backream, keep MW and inhibitor up, sweep before trips.
outcome: Freed with jarring in most cases.

title: Gas influx in Kopili
problem: Gas influx with a small pit gain detected on flow-out.
cause: Under-balanced pore pressure in gas-bearing Kopili shale.
mitigation: Raise MW by 0.05-0.08 SG before drilling the top, flow-check every stand.
outcome: Well controlled with the driller method.

title: Poor cement bond across Tipam
problem: Cement returns lost and CBL shows a poor bond across Tipam.
mitigation: Use a lightweight lead slurry and centralisers; plan a two-stage job.

title: Tight hole in Girujan clay
problem: Tight spots and overpull in mottled Girujan clay.
mitigation: Add KCl-polymer inhibition and wiper trips every 300 m.
